entries.title: Typing stays smooth while crewmates start and get messages
entries.body: Typing in the message box could pause for a moment while several crewmates started or were messaged at once, and longer still once you had thousands of finished tasks. Your keys now appear without that delay, however many tasks you have.
entries.noPicture: The fix removes a short delay between a key and its letter, which a still picture cannot show.
